reference.authors: Ha J, Satin LS, Sherman AS
reference.title: A Mathematical Model of the Pathogenesis, Prevention, and Reversal of Type 2 Diabetes

state_unit_notes.glucose_mg_dl: mg/dL, as represented by the published model state
state_unit_notes.insulin_model_state: source-model state; unit not normalized here
state_unit_notes.beta_cell_state: relative/source-model state; not a measured cell count

limitations: Mechanistic model reproduction, not a clinically validated individual digital twin.
The baseline preset reproduces one published Figure 7 human model scenario.
Changing intervention timing or Si targets creates an exploratory model perturbation, not a drug effect estimate.
No pharmacokinetics, drug exposure, adherence, adverse-event, comorbidity, or competing-risk model is included.
